blocks.text: Multi-cloud tareeqe mein mukhtalif providers ki kai cloud services istemal ki jati hain. Is se kisi ek provider par inhisar (dependency) nahi rehta, aur bharosa (reliability) aur kaarkardagi (performance) behtar ho sakti hai.

Misal (Example): ek company data analytics ke liye Google Cloud Platform, apni karobari (enterprise) applications ke liye Microsoft Azure, aur backup aur disaster recovery (kisi aafat ke baad data wapas lana) ke liye Amazon Web Services istemal kar sakti hai. Is tarah agar ek provider mein masla aaye to company doosri services par bharosa kar sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Multi-cloud hybrid cloud se kaise mukhtalif hai?
blocks.explanation: Hybrid cloud public aur private cloud ko milati hai. Multi-cloud mein mukhtalif providers ki kai cloud services istemal hoti hain taake ek provider par inhisar na rahe.

items: Multi-cloud: mukhtalif providers ki services (Google Cloud, Azure, AWS).
Ek provider par inhisar nahi; ek mein masla ho to doosre kaam aate hain.
